name: Polly
source: Katya's abusive mother. She is a gorgeous woman, much appreciated by those around her, who strives to keep up appearances. In the eyes of all, she is a cheerful, pleasant woman and a loving mother, when in truth she is a hypocritical, sly and cruel woman who abuses her daughter physically and mentally.
